description: Several small toys and blocks are spread on the bed in front of a dark pillow, including a gray duck figure, a white bunny, a blue plush, and a light-blue toy pan. The left hand reaches in from the left toward the gray duck, pinches it, lifts it slightly, then moves right and lowers it into the blue pan before releasing; the right hand stays nearby and does not touch any object, so the duck is a left-hand object only during the move.
